purpose: Determine the endpoint kinds and unique-class-owner coverage of reads/writes edges in the frozen CloudStack Java graph. Do not combine these edges with references, infer source truth or score god objects.

graph.producerNote: Original release extraction; one omitted node and 45 omitted edges. No new extraction.

method.input: Read the frozen typed graph only; verify graph, producer and prior-review hashes before and after. Do not modify source or graph.
method.ownership: The direct directed contains edge from class to method or field supplies owner candidates. Only one distinct class owner is usable; zero or multiple owners are unavailable. Do not choose a first owner.
method.relations: For every reads or writes edge, count its exact source-kind/target-kind pair, evidence-confidence category and exact AST source anchor. Count missing endpoints separately. For method-to-field edges only, split field targets into same-class, other uniquely owned class, and unavailable owner; preserve record multiplicity and distinct source methods/field targets.
method.samples: Reuse all 55 prior reviewed class joins unchanged. Report observed own, foreign and unresolved method-to-field reads/writes by each uniquely joined class; keep seven unavailable joins unavailable.

outputs: Full endpoint-kind and evidence totals for reads and writes, all 13,001-class source cohort only where applicable, all 55 unchanged sample joins, exact source-anchor counts, ambiguity and limit outcomes, raw graph and producer SHA-256s, repeated verification. Do not calculate ATFD, TCC, WMC, a ranking or Graphify score.
interpretation: The preceding inventory observed 1,042 reads and 6,161 writes edges in this CloudStack artifact and none in the older Eclipse artifact; their endpoint semantics and source coverage are unknown at registration.
A stored edge is producer evidence, not an independent source oracle. Missing edges are not evidence that a class has no foreign-state access or is cohesive.
This remains known Java development data; no independent holdout or cross-language conclusion.
